text: Telescopes, marvels of modern technology, have revolutionized our understanding of the universe by allowing us to gather light from distant celestial objects and study their properties. These devices aid in observing galaxies, planets, and nebulae, providing crucial insights into the workings of the cosmos. Yet, the use of telescopes also raises intriguing questions about the fundamental nature of the universe and the laws of physics that govern its behavior. As we delve deeper into the mysteries of the universe, the profound implications of these questions continue to inspire scientific inquiry and fuel human curiosity.
summary: Telescope aids in viewing celestial objects, gathering light to study distant galaxies, planets, and nebulae, yet raises questions about the universe's nature and laws of physics.
